title: Database connection pool exhaustion
steps: Check pool maximum against previous release
Look for slow queries holding connections
Restore pool size through a reviewed config change

title: Slow query investigation
steps: Find the slowest statements
Check the query plan for missing indexes
Roll back the change or add the index

title: Event bus and queue backlog
steps: Check downstream provider status
Pause non-critical sends
Scale consumers only if the provider is healthy

title: Traffic surge and autoscaling limits
steps: Confirm traffic source (campaign, bot, retry storm)
Raise autoscaler maximum within quota
Enable load shedding for non-critical calls

title: Feature flag rollback
steps: Identify flags changed before onset
Turn the flag off for affected cohort
Confirm error rate recovers

title: Memory growth and OOM kills
steps: Confirm memory growth pattern
Check caches and buffers without limits
Restart as mitigation; fix the leak

title: Certificate renewal
steps: Identify the expired certificate
Rotate through the certificate pipeline
Add expiry alerting at 30 days
